title: Log the greeting
prompt:
Day Jay has already declared the variable, with its type. Now print it.

In TypeScript, console.log() prints to the console. Make the program print exactly:

Hello, world!
hints: console.log(...) prints whatever you put between the parentheses. You can pass it a variable.
Add this line under the declaration: console.log(greeting);
starter_code:
const greeting: string = "Hello, world!";
